falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 79% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal continuation lower rather than a completed bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28; sustained readings above 35 would indicate panic escalation beyond the referenced pattern, suggesting a more severe liquidation phase than the historical analog

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety bid in bonds with equity weakness would signal macro stress (recession/financial contagion) rather than the rate-cut-relief bottom of August 2024, breaking the pattern's economic context

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
